validate_rrule: validate an RRULE string and raise ValueError if malformed or exhausted
next_run_ns: compute the next RRULE occurrence as epoch nanoseconds respecting a timezone
next_n_runs_ns: compute the next N RRULE occurrences as epoch nanoseconds for UI preview
rrule_interval_seconds: approximate the interval between RRULE recurrences in seconds
scheduler_worker_loop: run the unified background scheduler for automation execution and calendar alerts
